title: Revit Working Library - Modeling

entries.name: Concept modeling intent
entries.geometry: low to medium; massing and key system placeholders
entries.information: minimal identity parameters and preliminary classification where known

entries.name: Design development modeling intent
entries.geometry: medium-high; constructible intent without fabrication minutiae
entries.information: parameters needed for issued drawings and schedules plus pre-spec identifiers/classification

entries.name: Construction / issue modeling intent
entries.information: complete schedule/tag information and selected product/manufacturer data where required

entries.name: In-place family decision
allowed_examples: temporary construction or visualization content not intended for scheduling/reuse
discouraged: copied in-place content used as pseudo-library

entries.name: Linked versus workshared model decision
worksharing_when: simultaneous authoring within one governed model scope

working_rules: Model only what is required for the declared use.
Avoid fabrication-level detail unless explicitly required.
Prefer reusable governed content over ad-hoc substitutes.
Project-specific LOD/LOI matrices and model breakdowns remain BEP configuration.

provenance.migration_note: Practical modeling and LOD/LOI guidance retained as non-authoritative working knowledge; source organization names removed.
